products.title: RINZEN Seika amber glass chain earrings
products.originalTitle: 【ピアス】アメリカンピアス 星華 -seika- 2ヶ (琥珀) | 切子 | 凛然

craftClassification.label: Contemporary kiriko jewelry by RINZEN; individual Edo Kiriko certification is not established.

products.size: Listed dimensions: W 1.7 × D 0.6 × H 2.7 cm. The listing does not separately specify the full chain length.
products.fastening: Chain-through pierced earrings; the Japanese listing explicitly describes threading the chain through the piercing.
products.taxNote: USD storefront display checked on the stated date; tax inclusion was not established.
products.editorialSummary: Amber glass, a star-like cut and a fine chain: a warm point of light to wear with charcoal, black or a crisp white shirt.
products.whoItMaySuit: For a wardrobe of clean lines, or anyone drawn to warm amber and a little geometric sparkle.
whatToCheck: The exact chain metal and skin-contact components are not specified in the checked product material list.
The product is marked Backorder OK. Its listed weight is 10 g without a clear per-ear or pair basis; full chain length is not specified.
Handmade glass may vary in color, shape and weight. The glass is not heat resistant.

products.title: 6.KILN Half-moon porcelain earrings
products.originalTitle: 【イヤリング】半月 | 有田焼 | 6.kiln

craftClassification.label: Porcelain jewelry listed as Imari-Arita Wares by BECOS; individual traditional-craft certification is not established.

products.size: W 1.1 × D 1.4 × H 8 cm, as listed.
products.findings: The item lists porcelain clay, sv925 and resin; the material assigned to each component is not specified.
products.fastening: Non-pierced earrings; the exact fitting mechanism is not specified in the checked text. A separate pierced version is a different SKU.
products.taxNote: USD storefront display checked on the stated date; tax inclusion was not established.
products.editorialSummary: Glossy white half-moons and fine gold-colored tassels give a simple outfit a playful, dressed-up finish.
products.whoItMaySuit: For those who like sculptural shapes, white porcelain and an accent that moves with the outfit.
whatToCheck: The maker is transitioning the reverse from white to a color matched to the fittings; either version may be supplied as a matching pair.
The listing gives a weight of 8 g without clarifying whether this is per earring or per pair. Exact skin-contact component coverage is not specified.
The gold-colored surface may scratch or peel if rubbed strongly; the product page gives gentle care guidance.

en.headline: Let amber catch the light.
en.standfirst: A clear star-like cut opens inside warm amber glass. Add the long, fine chain to a clean neckline and make a little kiriko your evening accent.
highlights: Warm amber with a clear, star-like cut
A geometric drop on a fine chain
Try charcoal, black or crisp white

outfit.title: Charcoal shirt × amber light
outfit.body: Try an open charcoal shirt or a simple black top, with one side of your hair swept back. Let the warm glass be the only strong color around your face.

ja.headline: 琥珀色に、光をひとしずく。
ja.standfirst: あたたかな琥珀色の中に、星のような透明のカット。細いチェーンとガラスのかたちを見せて、いつもの黒い服に切子のきらめきを。
highlights: 琥珀色と透明のカットのコントラスト
細いチェーンに揺れる幾何学のかたち
黒・チャコール・白シャツと合わせて

outfit.title: チャコールのシャツ × 琥珀色
outfit.body: チャコールのシャツやシンプルな黒いトップスに、髪を片側だけ耳にかけて。顔まわりの色を抑えると、あたたかなガラスの色がコーディネートのポイントになります。

en.headline: A little moon, a little movement.
en.standfirst: Smooth white porcelain meets a playful fringe of gold-colored chains. Half-moon is a sculptural accent for an easy blouse or a dressed-up evening.
highlights: Fine tassels that add a playful line
Pair with soft pink, ivory or navy

outfit.title: Blush blouse × a loose updo
outfit.body: Pair the white porcelain with a soft pink blouse and loosely tied hair. For a more graphic look, try navy or black and keep the neckline simple.

ja.headline: 白い半月に、揺れる遊び心。
ja.standfirst: つるんとした白磁に、金色のチェーンをひと房。やわらかなブラウスにも、少しおめかしする夜にも合わせたい、半月のイヤリング。
highlights: つやのある白磁の半月シルエット
細いタッセルが描く軽やかなライン
淡いピンク・アイボリー・ネイビーに

outfit.title: 淡いピンクのブラウス × ゆるいまとめ髪
outfit.body: やわらかなピンクのブラウスに、髪はふんわりとまとめて。白い半月とチェーンを見せるコーディネートです。ネイビーや黒に合わせれば、かたちのコントラストを楽しめます。

internalVisualReview.publicUse: No official product photograph copied into public assets. AI imagery may use the researched design cues, with visible AI/non-product-photo disclosure.
internalVisualReview.rinzen: Amber kite-like glass, clear radiating lower cut, gold-colored thin chain; choose a distinctive adult Japanese woman, short dark bob and charcoal/black. Avoid unsupported exact chain length or precious-metal claims.
internalVisualReview.sixKiln: Glossy white vertical half-moon, thin gold-colored rim, several uneven fine chain tassels, non-pierced type; choose a cute adult Japanese woman, soft fringe or loose updo and blush/ivory. AI image is not an accurate product or fitting rendering.
